title: Prospective Imaging Assessment of Perineo-pelvic Static's Evolution After Sexual Reassignment Surgery in MtF Transgender Patient, by Peno-scrotal Inversion Vaginoplasty Technique (TRANSPELV)
official: Prospective Imaging Assessment of Perineo-pelvic Static's Evolution After Sexual Reassignment Surgery in MtF Transgender Patient, by Peno-scrotal Inversion Vaginoplasty Technique (TRANSPELV)
summary: The research consists of adding to the usual MtF transgender patient undergoing vaginoplasty care course, static and dynamic perineo-pelvic MRI before, and at 6 and 24 months. The aim is to assess perineo-pelvic static's evolution, based on the appearance of a rectocele.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient over 18 years old
* Patient admitted in urology ward at Limoges' University Hospital for MtF sexual reassignment surgery by vaginoplasty
* Patient affiliated or benefitting from a social security system
* Patient free, informed, written and signed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient admitted for vulvoplasty surgery
* Patient admitted for second vaginoplasty surgical gesture
* Contraindication of realizing an MRI
